paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: (left) and (right) on GSM8K with different settings: decoding length L, sampling steps S, refresh intervals and the window size.

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between performance, measured as accuracy percentage on the y-axis, and speed, measured in tokens per second on the x-axis. The y-axis is labeled "Performance (Accuracy %)" and ranges from 65 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. The x-axis is labeled "Speed (Tokens/s)" and ranges from 20 to 160 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. There are two distinct sets of lines: one represented by blue shades and the other by red shades, with dashed and dotted lines indicating different pareto fronts. The blue lines represent different configurations with L=512 and varying S values (512, 256, 128), while the red lines represent configurations with L=128 and varying S values (64, 32). The blue lines are generally positioned at higher accuracy percentages and lower speeds compared to the red lines. The dotted line, labeled "LLaDA Pareto Front", connects points across different configurations, starting at around 82% accuracy at 20 tokens/s and decreasing to approximately 68% at 100 tokens/s. The dashed line, labeled "Cache Pareto Front", starts at around 84% accuracy at 10 tokens/s and decreases to about 62% at 170 tokens/s. Each line within the blue and red groups is distinguished by different marker shapes and shades corresponding to different refresh intervals, with the lines generally trending downward as speed increases.
